text: A white square open-topped tray sits centrally on a light grey perforated metal workbench. Its flat inner floor is empty except for a small teal/green plastic block with four square recesses (a 2x2 cell holder) resting near the centre, upright. Six small screw heads are visible in the tray floor. On the tray's near rim are two small white knob-like pegs at left and right and a black angular fixture at centre. To the left lies a white card with a printed black-and-white fiducial marker, and a blue-and-orange labelled device at the frame edge. Top centre shows a grey metal bracket with vertical posts; right side has a white rail and a black cable. No liquids visible.
